questions.prompt: What hardware implements the link layer in a host? Give the three-letter abbreviation.
Which layers does a NIC implement?
The link layer is purely software: it runs on the CPU like the transport layer.
On the sending side, what does the NIC do with the datagram it gets from the network layer?
options: Looks up the destination's IP address
Encrypts it and sends it to the router
Encapsulates it in a frame, adding a header and error-checking bits

questions.prompt: On the receiving side, what's the last thing the link layer does with a good frame?
options: Forwards it out of every port
Extracts the datagram and passes it up to the network layer

questions.prompt: What does a NIC plug into so the CPU can hand it data? (two words: host ______)
Which device is strictly a layer 1 device, repeating every signal out of every port?
Hypervisors connect virtual machines with virtual switches.
